summary_en: KJ005 Corporation's tender offer for Taiyo Holdings shares is on track to launch in late November 2026, with most required regulatory approvals from Japan, Taiwan, Germany, Tunisia, Vietnam, and the US completed. Pending approvals in China and Japan remain under way, with completion expected by end of November 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Progress Status Toward Implementation of Tender Offer for Our Shares by KJ005 Corporation
translation_en_brief:
On October 9, 2026, Taiyo Holdings provided an update on the progress of a tender offer for its shares by KJ005 Corporation. The bidder is proceeding with obtaining necessary regulatory approvals under competition and investment laws across multiple jurisdictions. As of the announcement date, required approvals have been completed in Japan, Taiwan, Germany, Tunisia, Vietnam, and the United States. Approvals in China and under Japan's foreign investment regulations remain pending but are expected to be completed by end of November 2026.

The bidder originally announced in March 2026 that the tender offer would commence in early October 2026, subject to satisfaction of regulatory conditions. The bidder has now revised its target launch date to late November 2026 pending final regulatory clearances. The bidder intends to commence the tender offer as soon as all pending regulatory approvals are obtained or formally waived. The company stated it will promptly notify shareholders if the bidder formally commences the offer or if the target launch date changes.
